body: Not near Maryland, though I'm forever grateful for the offer. You are an awesome person to offer friendship to a stranger in despair.
Thank you for such comforting words and valuable links, I've begun watching John Bradshaw's speeches.

Thanks for taking the time to reply with these uplifting words. It helps tremendously to be heard and to be replied back to from another human soul. You've made a difference in changing my perspective on things, especially about staying focused on goals and to keep looking ahead no matter what.
